source_file: SD408 How to complete the audit report v3 10/11/2022
summary: Initial profile guidance generated from uploaded official how-to/checklist documents. Detailed report sections should be concise, objective and evidence-based; non-conformities must be recorded in the relevant detailed section and NC summary tables.
global_rules: Do not alter, duplicate, delete or move XML tags/content controls in official BRCGS templates.
Dates in report and NC tables must use YYYY-MM-DD where required.
Non-conformity clause references must match the clause format in the Standard.
Do not add new columns to official tables; only use existing table structure and additional rows where permitted.
